notes: Secure Scheduling (SMC 14.22) covers hourly employees of retail and food-service establishments with 500+ employees worldwide.
Predictability pay: 1 hour of pay for hours added or a shift date/time changed after posting; half the hours not worked when sent home early (extra key reduced_hours_fraction).
Employees may decline hours not on the originally posted schedule.
Right to rest premium is 1.5x for hours worked within the <10 h gap between a closing and the next opening shift.

rules.summary: Covered retail employers (500+ employees worldwide) must post schedules 14 days ahead and pay predictability pay for later employer changes.

citation.title: Seattle Office of Labor Standards — Secure Scheduling Ordinance
citation.excerpt: Covers hourly employees at retail and food services establishments with 500+ employees worldwide ... at least 14 days in advance

rules.summary: Hours worked between a closing and opening shift less than 10 hours apart are paid at 1.5x.

citation.title: Seattle Office of Labor Standards — Secure Scheduling Ordinance
citation.excerpt: Pay time-and-a-half for any hours worked between closing and opening shifts that are separated by less than 10 hours

rules.summary: Seattle's minimum wage is $21.30 an hour in 2026 for all employers.

citation.title: Seattle Office of Labor Standards — Minimum Wage
citation.excerpt: 2026 minimum wage $21.30; since January 1, 2025 all employers, regardless of size, pay the same minimum wage
